definitions.source: directive 022, ec.phase.evaluate_group sums['reg'], flicker 0, speed classes pooled
definitions.tau_reg: median of the regular intervals (two consecutive intervals a, b of one pixel and polarity with max <= 1.2 min, min > 0, a + b <= T0) over [(w - 3) T0, (w + 1) T0), windows w - 3 to w; the scored window w + 1 is excluded; hot pixels removed first
definitions.N: true events of window w + 1 of the pixel-polarity, per pixel-polarity in the union of the true and moved keys of an entering block, binned by r = dt / tau_reg of that pixel-polarity
definitions.N2: moved events (window w moved by the block's shift and onset delay) landing in window w + 1, same keys
definitions.M: sum over voxels (1 px, T0 / k, polarity) of min(true, moved)
definitions.M0: as M with the moved times redrawn uniformly in window w + 1 (null)
definitions.unmatched: a pixel-polarity with true events and no moved event enters with N2 = 0, M = 0; one with moved events and no true event enters with N = 0, M = 0; both lower F
definitions.motion: estimated per 20 x 20 block on the pair (w - 1, w) by ec.phase.choose_shift (pairs of directive 020, ties within 2 sqrt(m) to the smallest |dx| + |dy|), onset delay as ec.phase.onset_delay; causal; not the exact motion of Eq. (binfidmoved)
definitions.F: 2 M / (N + N2) pooled over groups and recordings (event-weighted); F0 = 2 M0 / (N + N2)
definitions.F_ci95: bootstrap over the recordings of the stratum, 2000 resamples, seed 20261016
definitions.n_recordings: recordings with N > 0 in the bin
definitions.r_centre: th_reduce.bin_centre (geometric centre; NaN for [128, inf) and the no-tau bin)
definitions.F_k1_same_pixels: F on grid (1, 1) of bin k1_bin, which holds the same pixel-polarities (k1_bin = bin + 10 for (1, 32), bin + 12 for (1, 64)); count matching alone, an upper bound of F
definitions.plotted_rule: N >= 10000 and n_recordings >= 5 (scripts/fig_028.py), on (1, 32), over the rows of 'grids'
definitions.rows: 'grids' holds the bins of r with a finite centre (bins 0 to 28 of ec.threshold.R_EDGES); the bin [128, inf) and the bin of pixel-polarities without tau_reg have no r and are in 'other_bins'
